column1: # LI RE: phase 8 part 4 step B (CLEANSLATE_PLAN.md): the island request names the faith's own holy order.

column2:
My dear [Root.GetTitledName]
Our order has long sought a stronghold that is easily defended, from where we can shield all [Root.Religion.GetName] souls. We think your newfound lands in [potential_title.GetBaseName] might be the perfect place, and we would pay you well for your troubles.

Signed,
[holy_order_target.GetTitledName]

The magnanimous [island_donor.GetTitledName] has granted the island of [potential_title.GetBaseName] to the [holy_order_target.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. From this stronghold the order will guard the seas for all the faithful of [holy_order_target.Religion.GetName], and [holy_order_target.GetTitledFirstName] vows to go on defending the faith and those who follow it.
